introduction: This spec defines the workspace-level foundations for the carry-patch workflow in af-hub: a new `carry_patch` workspace mode, dual-remote clone setup, upstream credential management, and a declarative ordered patch list per workspace. Note: requirements referencing git_runner_extensions APIs (RemoteAdd, ConfigSet, CreateBranch) are based on PRD assumptions and should be cross-checked against the installed library before implementation.

glossary.ConfigSet: A GitRunner method (from the git_runner_extensions spec) that sets a git configuration key-value pair in a repository.
glossary.CreateBranch: A GitRunner method (from the git_runner_extensions spec) that creates a local branch at a specified commit or reference.
glossary.GitRunner: The Go struct (from spec 11) that executes git CLI commands with protocol allowlists and environment isolation.
glossary.RemoteAdd: A GitRunner method (from the git_runner_extensions spec) that adds a named remote to a git repository.
glossary.UPSTREAM_GIT_PASSWORD: A workspace secret key storing a password for basic authentication against the upstream remote.
glossary.UPSTREAM_GIT_PAT: A workspace secret key storing a personal access token for authenticating against the upstream remote.
glossary.UPSTREAM_GIT_USERNAME: A workspace secret key storing a username for basic authentication against the upstream remote.
glossary.WriteAPIError: The apikit function used to write standardized JSON error responses to HTTP clients.
glossary.active: A patch status indicating the patch is included in the next integration branch rebuild.
glossary.added_at: An RFC 3339 timestamp column in the patches table recording when a patch was added.
glossary.afc: The command-line interface for the af-hub platform.
glossary.apikit: The server framework library (github.com/txsvc/apikit) used for HTTP routing, authentication, and CLI scaffolding in af-hub.
glossary.branch_name: The name of the git branch associated with a patch entry in the patches table.
glossary.carry_patch: A workspace mode that enables dual-remote clone setup, upstream credential management, and a declarative ordered patch list for maintaining a fork with pending upstream PRs.
glossary.conflict: A patch status indicating the most recent rebuild failed when applying this patch; the patch is still included in subsequent rebuild attempts.
glossary.deleteWorkspace: The existing Go function in store.go that deletes a workspace and its associated data within a transaction.
glossary.disabled: A patch status indicating an operator has manually excluded this patch from rebuild.
glossary.integration_branch: A TEXT column on the workspaces table naming the mechanically rebuilt branch that combines the upstream base with all carried patches; defaults to 'deploy'.
glossary.merged_upstream: A patch status indicating the patch branch has been detected as merged into upstream; the patch is excluded from rebuild and automatically deleted after a successful rebuild.
glossary.patch: A record in the patches table representing a git branch that should be applied on top of the upstream base when rebuilding the integration branch.
glossary.patches: A SQLite table storing the ordered list of patch entries for carry-patch workspaces, each representing a git branch to be applied during integration branch rebuild.
glossary.patches:read: A PAT permission scope granting the ability to list and view patches for a workspace.
glossary.patches:write: A PAT permission scope granting the ability to add, remove, update, and reorder patches for a workspace.
glossary.position: A 1-based INTEGER column in the patches table indicating the application order of a patch; lower values are applied first.
glossary.reorder: A bulk patch operation that accepts a complete ordered list of patch IDs and reassigns positions accordingly.
glossary.rerere.autoupdate: A git configuration key that causes git to automatically stage files resolved by rerere.
glossary.rerere.enabled: A git configuration key that enables the reuse-recorded-resolution mechanism, allowing git to replay previously recorded conflict resolutions.
glossary.resolveCloneAuth: The existing Go function that resolves authentication credentials for the origin (fork) remote.
glossary.resolveUpstreamAuth: A Go function that resolves authentication credentials for the upstream remote, falling back to origin credentials if upstream-specific secrets are absent.
glossary.standard: The default workspace mode representing existing single-remote behavior with no upstream URL, patch list, or rebuild operations.
glossary.updated_at: An RFC 3339 timestamp column in the patches table recording when a patch was last modified.
glossary.upstream_pr_url: An optional TEXT column in the patches table holding the URL of the corresponding upstream pull request.
glossary.upstream_url: A TEXT column on the workspaces table holding the URL of the upstream repository for carry-patch workspaces.
glossary.workspace_mode: A TEXT column on the workspaces table indicating whether a workspace operates in 'standard' (single-remote) or 'carry_patch' (dual-remote with patch list) mode.
glossary.workspace_slug: The unique slug identifier for a workspace, used as a foreign key in the patches table.

user_story.goal: have workspaces store their mode, upstream URL, and integration branch name in the database
user_story.benefit: the system can distinguish carry-patch workspaces from standard ones and apply the correct behavior

acceptance_criteria.trigger: the hub starts up against an existing database that lacks the new columns

acceptance_criteria.return_contract: table is created with all three columns present; no ALTER TABLE statements are needed

acceptance_criteria.action: enforce that `workspace_mode` is always non-null with a default value of 'standard' for every row
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: any INSERT that omits workspace_mode stores 'standard'; any INSERT that sets workspace_mode to NULL is rejected by the database constraint

user_story.goal: have carry-patch workspaces automatically configured with a second upstream remote and rerere settings at clone time
user_story.benefit: the workspace is ready for integration branch rebuilds without manual git configuration

acceptance_criteria.action: log the failure as a warning, mark the workspace clone_status as 'ready' (not failed), and continue

acceptance_criteria.action: perform the standard single-remote clone without adding an upstream remote, setting rerere config, or creating an integration branch

requirements.title: Cascade Delete Patches on Workspace Deletion

user_story.goal: have all patches for a workspace automatically deleted when the workspace is deleted
user_story.benefit: the database does not accumulate orphaned patch rows after workspace deletion

acceptance_criteria.action: include DELETE FROM patches WHERE workspace_slug = ? in the existing cascade delete transaction alongside other workspace-associated data deletions
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: all patch rows for the workspace are deleted atomically with the workspace row; no orphaned patches remain
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a workspace deletion is executed

edge_cases.action: roll back the entire transaction including the workspace row deletion
edge_cases.return_contract: workspace and all its patches remain in the database; caller receives an error
edge_cases.error_condition: the DELETE FROM patches statement fails within the transaction

edge_cases.action: execute DELETE FROM patches WHERE workspace_slug = ? which affects zero rows; continue the transaction normally
edge_cases.return_contract: workspace is deleted successfully; zero-row delete does not cause an error
edge_cases.trigger: a workspace with no patches is deleted

correctness_properties.title: Patch Position Contiguity
correctness_properties.invariant: the set of position values in the patches table for that workspace is always exactly {1, 2, ..., N} with no gaps and no duplicates

correctness_properties.title: Branch Name Uniqueness Per Workspace
correctness_properties.invariant: no two patches in the patches table share the same (workspace_slug, branch_name) pair

correctness_properties.title: Integration Branch Not in Patch List
correctness_properties.for_any: carry_patch workspace with a defined integration_branch
correctness_properties.invariant: no patch in the patches table for that workspace has branch_name equal to the workspace's integration_branch

correctness_properties.title: Standard Workspace Has No Upstream Fields
correctness_properties.invariant: upstream_url is NULL and integration_branch is NULL in the workspaces table

correctness_properties.title: Carry-Patch Workspace Has Non-Null Upstream URL
correctness_properties.invariant: upstream_url is non-null and non-empty in the workspaces table

correctness_properties.title: No Orphaned Patches After Workspace Deletion
correctness_properties.invariant: the patches table contains no rows with workspace_slug equal to the deleted workspace's slug

correctness_properties.title: Reorder Preserves Patch Count
correctness_properties.for_any: reorder operation on a workspace with N patches
correctness_properties.invariant: after a successful reorder, the workspace still has exactly N patches with positions {1, 2, ..., N}

correctness_properties.title: Immutable Structural Fields After Creation
correctness_properties.for_any: workspace that has been successfully created
correctness_properties.invariant: workspace_mode, upstream_url, and integration_branch values in the workspaces table never change after the initial INSERT

correctness_properties.title: Upstream Auth Fallback Completeness
correctness_properties.invariant: resolveUpstreamAuth always returns a non-error result when resolveCloneAuth would return a non-error result for the same workspace

execution_paths.title: Create Carry-Patch Workspace and Clone with Dual-Remote Setup

steps.action: runs 'afc workspace create --mode carry_patch --git-url https://github.com/myfork/repo --upstream-url https://github.com/upstream/repo --integration-branch deploy'
sends POST /api/v1/workspaces with workspace_mode='carry_patch', git_url, upstream_url, and integration_branch='deploy'

validates upstream_url format, defaults integration_branch to 'deploy', inserts workspace row with workspace_mode='carry_patch' into the workspaces table, enqueues a clone job, and returns HTTP 201 with the workspace JSON including all three new fields
clones git_url as origin into the workspace directory using go-git PlainCloneContext
calls RemoteAdd to add a remote named 'upstream' pointing to upstream_url
calls ConfigSet to set rerere.enabled=true and rerere.autoupdate=true in the repository
calls CreateBranch to create a local branch named 'deploy' at the upstream tracking branch HEAD
updates workspace clone_status to 'ready' in the workspaces table

execution_paths.title: Add Patch with Explicit Position and Verify List Order

steps.action: runs 'afc patch add my-workspace --branch feature/auth-headers --position 2 --upstream-pr https://github.com/upstream/repo/pull/42'
sends POST /api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/patches with branch_name='feature/auth-headers', position=2, upstream_pr_url set

verifies workspace is carry_patch mode, checks branch_name is not integration_branch, checks branch_name is not already in patches table, shifts existing patches at position >= 2 down by one, inserts new patch row with generated UUID, status='active', added_at and updated_at set to current time
returns HTTP 201 with JSON patch object
runs 'afc patch list my-workspace'
sends GET /api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/patches
queries patches table ordered by position ascending and returns HTTP 200 with JSON array showing the new patch at position 2 and all others shifted accordingly
runs 'afc patch reorder my-workspace uuid-3 uuid-1 uuid-2'
sends POST /api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/patches/reorder with patch_ids=[uuid-3, uuid-1, uuid-2]
verifies all patch IDs belong to the workspace and the list is complete and duplicate-free
within a single database transaction, updates position of uuid-3 to 1, uuid-1 to 2, uuid-2 to 3, and sets updated_at for each
returns HTTP 200 with JSON array of all patches in the new position order
sends DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace
begins a database transaction
executes DELETE FROM patches WHERE workspace_slug = 'my-workspace' within the transaction
executes DELETE FROM workspaces WHERE slug = 'my-workspace' and other cascade deletes within the same transaction
commits the transaction; workspace row and all associated patch rows are removed atomically
returns HTTP 204 with no body

execution_paths.title: Resolve Upstream Credentials with Fallback to Origin

steps.action: needs to authenticate against the upstream remote for a carry_patch workspace
looks up UPSTREAM_GIT_PAT in workspace secrets store
returns not-found for UPSTREAM_GIT_PAT
looks up UPSTREAM_GIT_USERNAME and UPSTREAM_GIT_PASSWORD in workspace secrets store
returns not-found for both
calls resolveCloneAuth (spec 09) to obtain origin credentials and returns the result
uses the returned BasicAuth credentials to authenticate the upstream remote fetch

error_handling.condition: POST /api/v1/workspaces with workspace_mode='carry_patch' and missing or empty upstream_url
error_handling.behavior: returns HTTP 400 with JSON error body via WriteAPIError

error_handling.condition: POST /api/v1/workspaces with workspace_mode='carry_patch' and upstream_url that fails URL validation
error_handling.behavior: returns HTTP 400 with JSON error body via WriteAPIError

error_handling.condition: POST /api/v1/workspaces with workspace_mode='standard' and upstream_url or integration_branch provided
error_handling.behavior: returns HTTP 400 with JSON error body via WriteAPIError

error_handling.condition: PATCH /api/v1/workspaces/:slug with workspace_mode, upstream_url, or integration_branch in the request body
error_handling.behavior: returns HTTP 400 with JSON error body via WriteAPIError; no fields are modified

error_handling.condition: POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/patches on a workspace with workspace_mode='standard'
error_handling.behavior: returns HTTP 400 with JSON error body via WriteAPIError

error_handling.condition: POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/patches with branch_name already in the patch list for this workspace
error_handling.behavior: returns HTTP 409 with JSON error body via WriteAPIError

error_handling.condition: POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/patches with branch_name equal to the workspace's integration_branch
error_handling.behavior: returns HTTP 400 with JSON error body via WriteAPIError

error_handling.condition: POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/patches/reorder with incomplete, duplicate, or foreign patch ID list
error_handling.behavior: returns HTTP 400 with JSON error body via WriteAPIError; no positions are modified

error_handling.condition: PATCH or DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/patches/:id where the patch ID does not exist for the workspace
error_handling.behavior: returns HTTP 404 with JSON error body via WriteAPIError

error_handling.condition: any patch endpoint called by a PAT without the required patches:read or patches:write scope
error_handling.behavior: returns HTTP 403 with JSON error body

error_handling.condition: post-clone setup step (RemoteAdd, ConfigSet, or CreateBranch) fails after core clone succeeds
error_handling.behavior: logs a warning; workspace clone_status is set to 'ready'; no error is propagated to the job queue

error_handling.condition: UPSTREAM_GIT_USERNAME is set but UPSTREAM_GIT_PASSWORD is absent in workspace secrets
error_handling.behavior: resolveUpstreamAuth skips the username/password branch and falls back to resolveCloneAuth; no error is returned

error_handling.condition: workspace does not exist or is not active when a patch operation is attempted
error_handling.behavior: returns HTTP 400 with JSON error body via WriteAPIError
